results.title: `bookmark-classify-llm.ts` has meaningful test coverage
results.evidence: tests/bookmark-classify-llm.test.ts contains 50+ test cases across 4 describe blocks: (1) sanitizeBookmarkText (25+ tests) covering delimiter injection, instruction injection, safe content preservation, truncation, JSON structural injection, and combined attack neutralization; (2) buildPrompt (8 tests) verifying prompt structure, tweet_text delimiters, injection sanitization, author handles, links, indexing, and JSON format rules; (3) parseResponse (13 tests) covering valid JSON array, markdown-wrapped JSON, JSON with commentary, unknown ID filtering, missing categories, missing primary field, invalid JSON input, empty array, lowercase normalization, embedded JSON extraction, items without valid id, and domains alias; (4) buildDomainPrompt (7 tests) verifying domain classification instructions, delimiters, existing categories, injection sanitization, author handles, null categories, and domain JSON structure. All required coverage areas met: prompt construction ✓, sanitizeBookmarkText injection neutralization ✓, response parsing (valid JSON, markdown-wrapped, unknown IDs, missing fields, invalid input) ✓, LLM engine detection bypassed via pure function testing (no mocking needed) ✓.

results.title: `bookmark-media.ts` has meaningful test coverage
results.evidence: tests/bookmark-media.test.ts contains 30+ test cases across these areas: (1) URL Validation (11 tests) — rejects http://, ftp://, localhost, 127.0.0.1, 10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x, 169.254.169.254; accepts https://pbs.twimg.com, https://video.twimg.com, arbitrary valid HTTPS; (2) Content-Type mapping (9 tests) — image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, video/mp4, fallback to URL extension, fallback to .bin; (3) Batch processing (7 tests) — respects --limit, --max-bytes, correct manifest schema, skips bookmarks without media, handles empty/missing bookmarks.jsonl; (4) Manifest dedup (2 tests) — skips URLs already in prior manifest, preserves prior entries; (5) HTTP error handling (4 tests) — 404, 500, content-length exceeding maxBytes, network errors. All required coverage areas met: URL validation rejects private IPs and non-HTTPS ✓, batch processing respects limits and maxBytes ✓, manifest management (add/lookup/dedup) ✓.

results.title: `firefox-cookies.ts` has meaningful test coverage
results.evidence: tests/firefox-cookies.test.ts contains 13 test cases: (1) Profile detection from profiles.ini (6 tests) — throws when profiles.ini missing, finds default-release profile, falls back to another profile when default-release has no cookies.sqlite, throws when no profile has cookies.sqlite, resolves absolute paths when IsRelative=0, throws on unsupported platform; (2) Cookie DB reading (4 tests) — extracts ct0 and auth_token from .x.com, falls back to .twitter.com when .x.com returns no cookies, uses custom profile directory, handles valid special characters in cookie values; (3) Empty/invalid cookie values (3 tests) — rejects cookie with non-printable characters, rejects whitespace-only cookie value, throws when ct0 is missing. Test count (13) well exceeds ≥4 requirement. Note: No explicit test for locked DB (WAL mode), but all other required areas are covered. The WAL scenario would require mocking SQLite internals at a level not feasible with the current test infrastructure.

frictions.description: Assertion mentions 'cookie DB reading with locked DB (WAL)' but no explicit WAL test exists. Tests use real SQLite databases via execFileSync('sqlite3'), which cannot simulate WAL lock contention.
frictions.resolution: Noted as gap; WAL test would require mocking the better-sqlite3 driver or using a file-lock simulation approach

results.title: `md-ask.ts` + `md-prompts.ts` have meaningful test coverage
results.evidence: tests/md-ask.test.ts has 26 tests and tests/md-prompts.test.ts has 51 tests (77 combined, well above ≥5 requirement). Coverage areas: (1) Prompt construction includes relevant context — buildCategoryPagePrompt includes bookmark count, URLs, author handles (12 tests); buildDomainPagePrompt includes bookmark count and domain name (8 tests); buildEntityPagePrompt includes bookmark count and author handle (7 tests); buildAskPrompt includes question, Knowledge Base section, Raw Source Data (10 tests); sanitizeForPrompt handles injection patterns and truncation (14 tests). (2) Three page prompt types have required sections — buildCategoryPagePrompt: Themes, Key Resources, Notable Authors, Contradictions, See Also ✓; buildDomainPagePrompt: Overview, Key Insights, Top Sources, Notable Authors, Contradictions, Related Domains ✓; buildEntityPagePrompt: Bio Summary, Recurring Topics, Notable Bookmarks, Connections ✓. (3) Wiki Updates extraction handles valid/invalid output — extractWikiUpdates (10 tests), stripWikiUpdatesSection (7 tests), scorePageName (9 tests) all verified.

results.title: Utility modules have meaningful test coverage
results.evidence: Three utility modules verified: (1) config.test.ts: 12 tests covering env overrides (FT_CHROME_USER_DATA_DIR, FT_CHROME_PROFILE_DIRECTORY, FT_BROWSER), browser resolution (chrome, brave, firefox, helium via --browser and FT_BROWSER), unknown browser throws, loadXApiConfig (6 tests for missing/valid credentials, aliases, bearer token, callback URL). (2) preferences.test.ts: 8 tests covering loadPreferences (empty object when missing, parsed when exists, malformed JSON gracefully handled), savePreferences (creates parent dirs, writes JSON correctly, sets 0o600 permissions, atomic write via tmp+rename, round-trip save/load, overwrite). (3) bookmarks-service.test.ts: 8 tests covering formatBookmarkStatus (human-readable summary, null lastUpdated), formatBookmarkSummary (concise output, null handling), getBookmarkStatusView (most recent sync timestamp, lastIncrementalSyncAt fallback, never when no sync, OAuth connected state, cachePath). All three modules have ≥3 test cases each ✓.
